lastCompletedStory.title: Embed the resolved issue record + derived branch into the auditor spawn payload

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-273) shipped: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts now exports buildAuditorTaskPrompt(issue, branchName) and deriveBranchNameFromIssueId(issueId), and runPlanWorkerSequence defaults auditorTaskPrompt to the record-bearing prompt built from the selected IssueEntry + its code-derived branch (never the removed static DEFAULT_AUDITOR_TASK_PROMPT). Re-plan rounds in runPlanPhaseWithReplan inherit this for free since runPlanPhase re-resolves `issue` every call. The subagent-auditor.md agent prompt file itself was intentionally NOT touched by this story (out of scope per notes/AC); if a follow-up story wants the auditor's own instructions updated to explicitly trust the embedded record over its own gh resolution steps, that is a separate change. file-size-budget.json ceiling for plan-runner.ts raised 1381->1444 with a dated _ref entry (CAM-273).
